scene.speaker: erik
scene.bubble: Top secret: Sofía's birthday is on Friday. We're going to prepare the BEST surprise party in club history!
scene.intro: Top secret! Sofía's birthday is on Friday, so the Club is going to prepare a surprise. Valentina is going to make the cake, Erik is going to invent something that throws balloons, and Mateo is going to invite everybody — quietly. Next week they are going to remember this party for a long time. What are YOU going to do at the weekend? Make a plan!
